text:
maria-cs: Morning — quick sync for Seabright day0 cutover. Network + KMS checklist before we flip traffic. TL;DR: need CIDR confirm, IAM role for inference, KMS alias/rotation, and audit log bucket write perms. Pinged infra 30m ago, no blockers yet.

daniel-sre: looking now. CIDR from Seabright is 10.200.0.0/16; we plan the NAT/proxy subnet at 10.200.1.0/24. Any overlap with their on‑prem VPN ranges?

maria-cs: They confirmed on‑prem is 192.168.0.0/22. I'll drop the network sheet here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/priv-deploys/seabright-network-sheet (internal).

kevin-eng: For IAM we'll create role redwood-seabright-priv-role with a trust policy to Seabright account 987654321098. Quick policy snippet for inference assume: 

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::987654321098:root"},
    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
  }]
}
```

We'll attach a least-privileges policy for model access + S3 read for model artifacts.

jasmin-cs: KMS: customer wants monthly rotation + key alias alias/seabright-prod. Proposed CMK ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:112233445566:key/9a8b7c6d-5e4f-3a2b-1c0d-9e8f7g6h5i4j. Need to confirm key grants to redwood service principal and to their operations account for emergency decrypt.

ops-bot: audit-bucket created: s3://rb-infer-seabright-audit-prod — bucket policy attached, encryption SSE-KMS using the CMK above, and CloudTrail delivery configured. Test object uploaded at 2023-11-10T14:12:03Z (internal test).

daniel-sre: I ran a quick write/read smoke to the bucket — logs arriving as expected. Please set lifecycle to 365d and block public access; I flagged that in the bucket policy PR.

maria-cs: Great. Remaining items: 1) KMS policy review (jasmin + kevin) 2) IAM cross-account assume test (kevin + daniel) 3) Canary inference tests + perf baseline (daniel). Who owns rotation runbook?

kevin-eng: I'll own the rotation runbook and PR the infra doc (repo: infra/priv-deploys). ETA ~2h. I'll include the ms-based rotation Lambda pattern and a tested key rotation schedule for monthly.

jasmin-cs: I'll confirm with Seabright that alias/seabright-prod is acceptable and that they want automated rotation or manual approval. Also confirming their SOC team wants logs forwarded to their Splunk cluster. If yes, need cross-account Kinesis/Firehose setup.

maria-cs: Scheduling: customer asked for 14:00–16:00 PT window. Proposed start 14:15 to allow final knobs. If infra green we flip at 14:15 and monitor 2 hours. Ops on standby.

maria-cs: @daniel-sre @kevin-eng please add a canary prompt set (short 1–2 token prompts + safety checks) and post latency/cpu/gpu-util numbers to #release-war-room during the first 30m. Also prepare rollback: route traffic back to hosted fallback model redwood-small-v1 and revoke new IAM role session if necessary.

daniel-sre: ACK :white_check_mark: I will script the canary (100 requests at t0, t+5m, t+15m) and push metrics.

kevin-eng: ACK :rocket: PR for rotation docs in progress. I'll also drop the IAM policy snippet into the ticket.

maria-cs: Thanks all — I'll capture any customer feedback in the retro doc after cutover and file follow-ups. Posting a short post‑mortem template link: https://redwood.internal/templates/priv-cutover-retro.

maria-cs: quick follow-up: if anyone hits a blocker, escalate to oncall and tag #release-war-room; I'll keep the customer on the line.

ops-bot: Reminder: runbook checklist item 7 (audit verification) marked DONE by ops-bot at 1765432178.

maria-cs: noted — last ask: can we add a short note in the console onboarding UI about the KMS alias name so customer's infra team sees expected alias? small UX win.

kevin-eng: will do.

maria-cs: thanks everyone — will update thread after the 2h monitor.
